output_list.criticism: The contract has an owner set in the constructor, which can be exploited for malicious behavior.
Reentrancy vulnerability exists where an attacker can manipulate the transfer function, causing unexpected repeated money transfers.
This vulnerability exists when the contract uses arithmetic operations (like uint256) for balance, which can result in truncated values due to limitations in the EVM stack.
Reentrancy vulnerability exists where an attacker can manipulate the approve function, causing repeated money transfers.
This vulnerability occurs when the balance value in the contract uses uint256, which can result in overflow and consequent loss of money.
Integral vulnerability exists where the balance value in the contract is not being updated, leading to potential unrecorded transactions.
